worst_flaw: The 85% target is set before any baseline under the new eligibility rules, and success is judged only against the pre-launch period, with no comparison group. That leaves no way to tell what the reward added beyond the resolution prompt, protected writing time and editors. The all-or-nothing group reward for the last two weeks also ignores leave and outages, gives no appeal path, and lets managers use private individual results for coaching without stated limits.
